_comment: High-impact US macro events that move the open. Times are US/Eastern on the RELEASE date. The guard blocks NEW ENTRIES around these; protective exits are never blocked. Update this file when the calendar is refreshed - it is read at every entry decision, so no restart is needed.

events.name: CPI (Oct)
events.note: m/m only (Oct-2025 shutdown gap). nowcast +0.24% headline / +0.21% core. Released 08:30 ET, one hour BEFORE the 09:30 open, so the reaction lands at the open - that is the trade this guard exists to prevent.

events.name: PPI (Oct)
events.note: Also feeds the Dec FOMC hike odds.

events.name: NFP (Nov)
events.note: First Friday of the month by convention - VERIFY against the official release calendar before relying on it.

events.name: FOMC decision
events.note: Mid-session release. Also sits inside the existing 14:00-16:00 kill zone, so this guard mainly adds the pre-release hour. Dec hike odds 76.8-78% after hot Oct NFP (+165k, 4.1% U).

events.name: Retail sales (Oct)
events.note: Released 08:30 ET, one hour BEFORE the 09:30 open, so the reaction lands at the open - same shape as the CPI/PPI guard. Consensus +0.2% (prior +0.8%); a miss with the 10y at 5.13% is exactly what this guard exists for. Feeds the Dec FOMC hike odds.

events.name: Industrial production + import prices
events.note: 15 minutes before the open, so the reaction lands at the open - the block carries into the first 45 minutes of the session (which the 08:30 retail-sales entry already blocks).

events.name: NAHB housing market index (Nov)
events.note: Mid-session release, low impact - blocks a short halo before the print only.

events.name: Home Depot earnings (Q3)
events.note: Pre-open print (EPS est 3.84, revenue est 42.81B per the 08:43 morning-planning brief). VERIFY the exact release time before relying on it. Pre-open event: the guard blocks the first 30 minutes of the open.

events.name: Disney earnings (Q4)
events.note: Pre-open print (EPS est 1.68, revenue est 25.21B per the 08:43 morning-planning brief). VERIFY the exact release time - Disney normally reports after the close, so confirm before trading on it. Pre-open event: the guard blocks the first 30 minutes of the open.

events.name: NVIDIA earnings (Q3)
events.note: AFTER the close. No new NVDA entries into the print; the reaction lands on tomorrow's open - see the Nov 18 reaction entry. Consensus rev ~108.9-109.2B, EPS 2.47, guide 108B +/-2%; implied move ~+/-10% on options vs a realised +/-2.6% average.

events.name: NVIDIA earnings reaction (Nov 17 print)
events.note: Blocks the first 45 minutes of the Nov 18 open - the window where the Nov 17 after-close NVDA print gets priced. NVDA is on the bot's blacklist (ledger -$432), so this is a book-level hedge, not an NVDA trade.

events.name: FOMC minutes
events.note: Minutes of the latest FOMC meeting, mid-session release. Same guard shape as the FOMC decision entry: the pre-release hour is what this adds (the 14:00-16:00 ET kill zone already covers part of it).

events.name: Anthropic IPO pricing (ANT)
events.note: The IPO price is set AFTER the close on Wed Nov 18; ANT trades on Thu Nov 19 (Nasdaq). Range $70-78, ~825M shares, up to $64.4B + $26B Class N, ~6x oversubscribed. VERIFY the exact pricing time. The reaction risk is the Thu debut - see the next entry.

events.name: Anthropic IPO debut (ANT)
events.note: ANT's first trade (Nasdaq, Thu Nov 19) - a fresh IPO can gap violently at the open, so the first 45 minutes of that session are blocked. Added beyond the requested event list because the Wed pricing print itself lands after the close; this is the window that actually carries the gap.
